title: Not a happy former customer
text: I ordered these boxes for my husband for Christmas. I was able to give him the first one in Christmas, it cane on time. However each one after that for 3 months was 2-4 weeks late. The boxes Shays had the she thing you never saw things like a watch or the bugger things it was always a tie, tie tack,, socks, sometimes cufflinks & handkerchief. We were both disappointed and I canceled my subscription. The sets were nice if your just wanting shine nice new ties & a few accessories.
label: negative
